email.subject: The handoffs costing Northstar replies
email.preview_text: A cleaner path from approved knowledge to an agent answer
email.body:
Northstar's support team loses handoffs between three disconnected queues every week. The evening shift is left rebuilding context before it can answer customers.

RelayDesk drafts support replies from approved knowledge articles for review. An agent remains responsible for checking the answer and deciding when it is ready to send.

That keeps the useful part of the existing support process while removing the blank page at the start of a reply. It does not require a claim about how Northstar works internally to make the mechanism relevant.

Take one recurring question and compare the draft with the answer the team already trusts.
